_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Reliability and Maintainability (R&M) Allocation Report
summary: Documents the methods and results of allocating reliability, maintainability, and Built-In Test (BIT) requirements from end-item quantitative requirements down to system, subsystem, and unit levels.
use_relationship:
Using system models, the Reliability and Maintainability (R&M) Allocation Report documents the methods and results of the allocation of the reliability, maintainability and Built-In Test (BIT) requirements.  End item quantitative requirements must be broken down to appropriate system/subsystem/unit levels necessary to establish requirements for designers and subcontractors.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, intended use information, and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task described in the solicitation or contract.

This DID should be tailored appropriately to each program.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Reliability and Maintainability (R&M) Allocation Report shall be in contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The R&M Allocation Report shall document the methods and results for allocating the reliability, maintainability and BIT requirements for each system/subsystem/unit, and shall include:

children.title: Description of how each indentured level is determined
children.content: Description of how each indentured level is determined, the end-item environments, the use duty cycles throughout the mission period and maintenance by which it will be supported.

children.title: The method used to allocate R&M
children.content: The method used to allocate R&M, including Built-In-Test (BIT), requirements to lower levels.

children.title: Description of trade-off methodology used to evaluate
children.content: Description of trade-off methodology used to evaluate alternatives and risks involved in achieving the allocations.

children.title: Description of processes used to create and manage allocation margin
children.content: Include a discussion regarding process for reassigning allocation as the design matures.

children.title: Results of the R&M (including BIT) allocations
children.content: Results of the R&M (including BIT) allocations for each of the system/sub-system/unit of which the end-item is composed.
